code_path: Fiscal services scan (`grep -rn 'loyalty_points|loyalty_transactions' app/Services/Fiscal/`) returns 0 matches — FiscalSequenceService, ZReportService, AuditLogService do NOT read or mutate any loyalty column. Z-close path has no coupling to loyalty balance / ledger.

Loyalty services scan (`grep -rn 'z_close|zClose|ZReport' app/Services/LoyaltyService.php app/Listeners/AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery.php app/Listeners/ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund.php app/Services/Loyalty/`) returns 0 functional matches — only a comment reference in PosRedemptionService:269.

AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery and ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund listeners are bound to OrderStatusChanged + RefundCreated events, both of which fire on per-order state transitions independent of the daily Z-close cycle.
audit_logs chain extension is triggered at PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment + FiscalSequenceService extensions, also independent of loyalty events.
cascade_hunts.semantic_note: Z-close finalizes the fiscal sequence + writes the daily z_reports row (HMAC-chained). Loyalty earn/redeem ledger writes continue across the Z-close boundary because (a) loyalty_transactions has its own immutable ledger separate from audit_logs and z_reports, and (b) the orders.loyalty_points_awarded sentinel is per-order not per-day. A redeem applied seconds after Z-close still reaches PosRedemptionService::applyToOrder normally and completes — there is no Z-close guard on the loyalty path.

known_acceptable_gaps.title: Partial refund triggers FULL awarded clawback (V1.0.2 backlog)
known_acceptable_gaps.v1_status: ACCEPTABLE — mirrors refundPoints semantics (full reversal on partial). Pro-rated clawback deferred to V1.0.2 once partial-refund cash-trail semantics are finalized.
known_acceptable_gaps.rationale: Customer-friendly bias: a partial refund still clears the entire earn — customer is not penalized with partial-points-remaining edge cases that could later confuse balance audits.

known_acceptable_gaps.title: No OTP / SMS phone verification at enrollment
known_acceptable_gaps.v1_status: ACCEPTABLE — V1 LOCAL single-resto, loyalty points have in-store-discount only (no cash-out path), fraud surface negligible. V2 SaaS / multi-branch may want OTP gate.
known_acceptable_gaps.v1_0_x_backlog: Optional: OTP via Twilio/Sendinblue on register() + opt-in() if owner wants stricter enrollment.
